ResearchProjectDef.label: ion propulsion
ResearchProjectDef.description: Electric thrusters and solar sails that need no fuel.

ResearchProjectDef.label: signature detection
ResearchProjectDef.description: Detectors that spot ships by heat and emissions.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ice processing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Turn ice into air, water and fuel.

ResearchProjectDef.label: drones
ResearchProjectDef.description: Bays for cleaning, hauling, mining and repair drones.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ship security
ResearchProjectDef.description: Internal turrets, bulkheads and security systems.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ship workshops
ResearchProjectDef.description: Benches for naval parts, suits and ammunition.

ResearchProjectDef.label: space stations
ResearchProjectDef.description: Station cores for orbit, asteroids and gas giants.

ResearchProjectDef.label: megastructures
ResearchProjectDef.description: Projects of many years: rings, collectors and habitats.

ThingDef.label: ship AI core
ThingDef.description: An onboard AI that assists the helm. Adds dodge and lets the ship fly with fewer crew.

ThingDef.label: fission reactor
ThingDef.description: A shielded fission reactor. 4,000 W. Burns one isotope every 20 days. Leaks radiation when badly damaged.

ThingDef.label: fusion reactor
ThingDef.description: A compact fusion reactor. 10,000 W. Burns two units of light gas per day.

ThingDef.label: exotic reactor
ThingDef.description: A reactor that taps exotic matter. 30,000 W. One unit lasts 60 days.

ThingDef.label: combat capacitor
ThingDef.description: Stores 500 Wd and releases it fast in combat.

ThingDef.label: ion thruster
ThingDef.description: An electric thruster. Thrust 40, no fuel, needs 1,500 W.

ThingDef.label: fusion thruster
ThingDef.description: A fusion drive. Thrust 250.

ThingDef.label: solar sail
ThingDef.description: A huge reflective sail. Tiny thrust, no fuel, no heat.

ThingDef.label: gas collector
ThingDef.description: Skims light gas from a gas giant or nebula. Produces 3 light gas per day.

ThingDef.label: ice processor
ThingDef.description: Melts ice into air and water. Each unit of ice is worth 20 APH.

ThingDef.label: water recycler
ThingDef.description: Recycles water and scrubs air. Adds a little air.

ThingDef.label: climate control
ThingDef.description: Ship-wide climate control. Removes heat.

ThingDef.label: retractable radiator
ThingDef.description: A radiator that folds into the hull in combat. Removes 4 UC/s when extended. Switch it off to retract.

ThingDef.label: emergency heat sink
ThingDef.description: Dumps 50 UC of heat at once by boiling off 10 ice.

ThingDef.label: probe launcher
ThingDef.description: Launches probes that extend sensor reach.

ThingDef.label: signature detector
ThingDef.description: Detects ships by their heat and emissions.

ThingDef.label: reactive armor
ThingDef.description: Explosive plates that blunt incoming hits. Adds hull points.

ThingDef.label: signature cloak
ThingDef.description: Masks the ship's signature. Makes it much harder to hit.

ThingDef.label: decoy emitter
ThingDef.description: Throws false echoes. A small dodge bonus.

ThingDef.label: hangar
ThingDef.description: A pressurized hangar for two shuttles or four fighters. Vehicles parked on or next to it are refuelled and repaired slowly, crewed fighters and bombers parked here join ship combat, and shuttles parked here can fly to your other maps in this star system.

ThingDef.label: shuttle bay
ThingDef.description: A bay for one shuttle. Vehicles parked on or next to it are refuelled and repaired slowly, crewed fighters and bombers parked here join ship combat, and shuttles parked here can fly to your other maps in this star system.

ThingDef.label: ice harvester
ThingDef.description: Grapples and drills ice from comets, rings and icy moons near the ship. Produces 20 ice per day.

ThingDef.label: mining bay
ThingDef.description: A bay with a mining laser. Produces a little rare metal and regolith each day.

ThingDef.label: salvage bay
ThingDef.description: Recovers steel from debris drifting near the ship.

ThingDef.label: docking port
ThingDef.description: A port where passing freighters dock to trade, about every ten days while powered (talk to them from a comms console). Raises the hull cell limit.

ThingDef.label: tug module
ThingDef.description: A tow rig with strong clamps. Adds thrust for towing.

ThingDef.label: security central
ThingDef.description: Shows hostiles aboard and can lock down every door.

ThingDef.label: orbital outpost core
ThingDef.description: The core of a first station off-world. Controls up to 600 cells. Supports your colonies in the same star system.

ThingDef.label: mining station core
ThingDef.description: A station core anchored to an asteroid. Produces ore every day. Supports your colonies in the same star system.

ThingDef.label: gas station core
ThingDef.description: A station core floating in a gas giant. Produces light gas every day. Supports your colonies in the same star system.

ThingDef.label: trade station core
ThingDef.description: A station core with beacons that attract freighters and merchants. Supports your colonies in the same star system.

ThingDef.label: shipyard station core
ThingDef.description: A station core that builds and repairs large ships. Supports your colonies in the same star system.

ThingDef.label: fortress core
ThingDef.description: A heavily armored station core for system defense. Supports your colonies in the same star system.

ThingDef.label: research station core
ThingDef.description: A station core packed with labs. Generates research. Supports your colonies in the same star system.

ThingDef.label: orbital ring control node
ThingDef.description: The control node of an orbital ring. The ring itself is built in orbit, stage by stage, as you supply each stage from here; its output grows with every finished stage. Supports your colonies in the same star system.

ThingDef.label: stellar collector control node
ThingDef.description: The control node of a swarm of collectors around the star. Each finished stage beams down more power, up to nearly limitless. Supports your colonies in the same star system.

ThingDef.label: giant habitat control node
ThingDef.description: The control node of a habitat for millions, built in orbit stage by stage. Its food and silver grow with every finished stage. Supports your colonies in the same star system.

ThingDef.label: deep observatory control node
ThingDef.description: The control node of an observatory that charts a whole sector. Research grows with every finished stage. Supports your colonies in the same star system.

ThingDef.label: wormhole stabilizer control node
ThingDef.description: The control node of a stabilizer built around a wormhole throat. Once its stages are done it anchors the wormhole and draws exotic matter from it. Supports your colonies in the same star system.

ThingDef.label: flak battery
ThingDef.description: Fires clouds of shrapnel at close range. 10 × 8 damage and a 70% chance to shoot down missiles.

ThingDef.label: beam laser
ThingDef.description: A continuous beam. 40 damage per second for three seconds.

ThingDef.label: plasma mortar
ThingDef.description: Lobs plasma shells that burn compartments. 120 area damage.

ThingDef.label: spinal cannon
ThingDef.description: A railgun along the ship's spine. 1,000 piercing damage. Capital ships only.

ThingDef.label: heavy torpedo tube
ThingDef.description: Slow torpedoes with an enormous warhead. 400 damage.

ThingDef.label: pulse missile launcher
ThingDef.description: EMP missiles that drain 300 shield points.

ThingDef.label: boarding torpedo tube
ThingDef.description: Sends up to four drafted crew to board the enemy from close range, not only when docked.

ThingDef.label: jamming emitter
ThingDef.description: Scrambles enemy targeting: -20% enemy accuracy while active.

ThingDef.label: mine layer
ThingDef.description: Drops proximity mines behind the ship. 60 damage per mine.

ThingDef.label: tow harpoon
ThingDef.description: Pins the enemy ship so it cannot flee.

ThingDef.label: rail battery
ThingDef.description: Twin rails that fire dense plasteel slugs. 3 × 70 piercing damage at long range. Uses rail slugs.

ThingDef.label: ruin weapon
ThingDef.description: A precursor weapon restored from an ancient wreck. 600 damage that ignores shields half the time.

ThingDef.label: corridor turret gun
ThingDef.description: A small turret that fires frangible rounds. Will not breach the hull.

ThingDef.label: corridor turret
ThingDef.description: A small turret that fires frangible rounds. Will not breach the hull.

ThingDef.label: internal laser turret gun
ThingDef.description: A laser turret with no ammunition. Draws power instead.

ThingDef.label: internal laser turret
ThingDef.description: A laser turret with no ammunition. Draws power instead.

ThingDef.label: stun turret gun
ThingDef.description: Stuns intruders so they can be captured.

ThingDef.label: stun turret
ThingDef.description: Stuns intruders so they can be captured.

ThingDef.label: airlock door
ThingDef.description: A heavy powered door rated for vacuum.

ThingDef.label: bulkhead door
ThingDef.description: A thick bulkhead between compartments.

ThingDef.label: blast door
ThingDef.description: An armored door that takes far longer to breach.

ThingDef.label: containment field
ThingDef.description: An energy barrier across a doorway. Very hard to breach while powered.

ThingDef.label: crew bunk
ThingDef.description: A stacked bunk that fits two sleepers in one cell.

ThingDef.label: cabin bed
ThingDef.description: A comfortable bed for a private cabin.

ThingDef.label: officer bed
ThingDef.description: A wide, well-made bed for officers.

ThingDef.label: compact cabin
ThingDef.description: A sealed sleeping pod with its own light and air vent.

ThingDef.label: zero-g sleeping bag
ThingDef.description: A strapped sleeping bag for zero gravity. Light and cheap.

ThingDef.label: fixed mess table
ThingDef.description: A bolted-down table for the mess hall.

ThingDef.label: mess bench
ThingDef.description: A long bench that seats crew at a mess table.

ThingDef.label: ship paste dispenser
ThingDef.description: Turns raw food in nearby hoppers into paste meals. Compact and airtight.

ThingDef.label: compact kitchen
ThingDef.description: A small electric galley for ship meals and drinks.

ThingDef.label: naval engineering bench
ThingDef.description: A bench for ship components and parts.

ThingDef.label: navigation table
ThingDef.description: Plot courses and study star charts. Counts as a research bench.

ThingDef.label: analysis lab
ThingDef.description: A lab bench for samples, drugs and medicine.

ThingDef.label: asteroid foundry
ThingDef.description: Smelts asteroid ore into alloys, ceramics and glass.

ThingDef.label: part fabricator
ThingDef.description: Fabricates naval components, cells and ammunition.

ThingDef.label: suit bench
ThingDef.description: Builds and repairs vacuum suits and armor.

ThingDef.label: ammunition bench
ThingDef.description: Assembles ship missiles, torpedoes and slugs.

ThingDef.label: ship weapon workshop
ThingDef.description: A heavy workshop for ship weapon parts.

ThingDef.label: infirmary bed
ThingDef.description: A medical bed with straps and monitors for zero gravity.

ThingDef.label: quarantine chamber
ThingDef.description: A sealed medical cell that speeds immunity to alien plagues.

ThingDef.label: decompression chamber
ThingDef.description: A pressure chamber that heals decompression injuries faster.

ThingDef.label: observation lounge window
ThingDef.description: A wide window panel for watching the stars drift by.

ThingDef.label: holographic game table
ThingDef.description: A table that projects strategy games. Needs adjacent seats.

ThingDef.label: ship gym
ThingDef.description: Resistance machines that fight bone loss in zero gravity.

ThingDef.label: flight simulator
ThingDef.description: A cockpit simulator. Fun, and trains pilots.

ThingDef.label: digital library
ThingDef.description: Terminals full of books, films and archives.

ThingDef.label: ship bar
ThingDef.description: A bar counter where the crew gathers. Brews reactor brew and moss tea.

ThingDef.label: onboard garden
ThingDef.description: A planter for flowers and moss. Beauty and a little air.

ThingDef.label: solar spectrum lamp
ThingDef.description: A full-spectrum lamp strong enough to grow crops.

ThingDef.label: emergency light
ThingDef.description: A red light that runs on almost no power.

ThingDef.label: status panel
ThingDef.description: A wall display with the ship's vital signs: hull, air, heat, fuel and crew.

ThingDef.label: ship name plate
ThingDef.description: A polished plate bearing the ship's name.

ThingDef.label: wall star map
ThingDef.description: A glowing map of the known stars.

ThingDef.label: ship pot
ThingDef.description: A small sealed pot for one decorative or hydroponic plant.

ThingDef.label: wall suit locker
ThingDef.description: A wall rack that holds two vacuum suits ready for use.

ThingDef.label: repair drone bay
ThingDef.description: An upgrade of the maintenance drone bay. Its drones repair hull, modules and parked vehicles within 30 cells.

ThingDef.label: cleaning drone bay
ThingDef.description: Launches drones that clean filth within 20 cells.

ThingDef.label: cargo drone bay
ThingDef.description: Launches drones that haul loose items to storage within 25 cells.

ThingDef.label: mining drone bay
ThingDef.description: Launches drones that mine designated rock within 25 cells.

ThingDef.label: drone workshop
ThingDef.description: Maintains the ship's drones. Every drone bay within 30 cells works 50% harder.

ThingDef.label: foam emitter
ThingDef.description: Floods the room with fire foam when it detects fire.

ThingDef.label: combat vent
ThingDef.description: On command, vents the air out of this room for an hour. For use against boarders.

ThingDef.label: internal proximity mine
ThingDef.description: A frangible trap for corridors. It kills boarders without breaching the hull.
